No. G949] PORT MORESBY, FRIDAY, 26th SEPTEMBER [2025

National Information and Communications Technology Act 2009

NOTICE OF MAKING MANDATORY INSTRUMENTS UNDER THE NATIONAL ICT ACT 2009

I, Kila Gulo-Vui, Chief Executive Officer of the National Information and Communications Technology Authority,
(also referred to as NICTA), by virtue of the powers conferred by Sections 55 and 218 of the National ICT Act
2009 and Section 6(1) of the National Information and Communications Technology (Operator Licensing)
Regulations 2010 and all other powers me enabling, hereby give notice of the following instrument that has been
made by NICTA pursuant to the National ICT Act 2009.

1. Regulatory Instrument;—

Standard and Special Conditions of Individual Licences Rule 2025 pursuant to Section 55 and 218 of the
National ICT Act 2009 and Section 6(1) of the National Information and Communications Technology
(Operator Licensing) Regulations 2010.

2. Commencement

This regulatory instrument takes effect from the date published herein.

Dated this 26th day of September, 2025.

K. GULO-VUI,
Chief Executive Officer,

Printed and Published by C. Lenturut, Government Printer,
Port Moresby.— 949,
